event_headline: Trump Administration Requires 780,000+ Temporary Visa Holders to Leave US to Apply for Green Cards
topic: Immigration Policy: Open Borders vs. National Control and Cultural Preservation

chronology.action: Announced new immigration policy requiring all immigrants in the US on temporary visas (students, H-1B workers, tourists) who want to apply for green cards to leave the US first, affecting 780,000+ immigrants

key_actors.name: Trump Administration
key_actors.role: Executive branch entity implementing immigration policy change
key_actors.stated_position: Temporary visa holders must leave US to apply for green card status

factual_claims.claim: The new policy affects 780,000+ immigrants currently in the United States
The policy applies to students, H-1B workers, tourists, and other temporary visa holders
Under the new policy, affected individuals must leave the US before applying for green cards

verified_facts.claim: The new policy affects 780,000+ immigrants currently in the United States
